headline_result: Every physical two-star packet delta=||A[R,p]||||A[q,C]||>0, including p=q, either has a literal physical appended-star cross block with E3 large enough for the existing E3 receiver, or its interbank block is within (2E3/delta)^(1/4) in Frobenius norm of rank <=2 with the stronger actual physical star as an exact rank-one factor. At the live delta>=2/9, E3<2^-18 scale the tail is <0.076546554462; the complementary E3 branch is continuously paid by <=82.760672.
